title: Homology factorization of the affine algebra counit on a K-injective complex
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,f_*\mathcal O_X)$ be its direct-image-algebra morphism [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Write $R=g_*$ for module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Let $P:\operatorname{Mod}(f_*\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ be additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits, with an adjunction $a:P\dashv R$. Let $I$ be a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] which is K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex] and whose cohomology modules are quasi-coherent in every integer degree. For each $n\in\mathbf Z$, there is an algebra-linear isomorphism $e:H^n(RI)\cong R(H^n(I))$ such that $H^n(\epsilon_I)=\epsilon_{H^n(I)}\circ P(e)\circ c_{RI}$. Here $\epsilon_I:P(RI)\to I$ is the termwise counit [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy], $\epsilon_{H^n(I)}$ is the ordinary counit, and $c_{RI}:H^n(P(RI))\to P(H^n(RI))$ is the canonical exact-functor homology comparison [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below]. No derived adjunction or derived-category existence assumptions occur in this statement.

theorem affine_algebra_kinjective_counit_homology_factorization
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    (P : SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [P.Additive] [Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits P] [Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits P]
    (a : P ⊣ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f))
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] (hI : ∀ n : ℤ, (I.homology n).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
          (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I).homology n ≅
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj (I.homology n),
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((a.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).counit.app I) n =
        (P.mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso (.up ℤ) n).hom.app
            (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
              (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
          P.map e.hom ≫ a.counit.app (I.homology n)
